milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate south to the carrot farm at (~5, ~0, ~10) relative to spawn. Farm is at z=9-12, requiring intentional movement (~12 blocks from spawn). Max distance of 5 ensures player actually walked to the farm rather than triggering from spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate east to observe the spruce fence pen structure centered at (~13, ~1, ~0). The pen spans x=10-16, z=-3 to 3. Max distance 8 requires approaching the pen area.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='mob', object='pig') because the task requires the pig to be lured INTO the pen. Pig starts at (~5, ~0, ~8) which is ~13 blocks from the pen gate. The pen has 2-high fences and a closed gate, preventing the pig from wandering in without player intervention (player must hold carrots to attract it). Box covers the pen interior.

milestones.task: Hook a zombie using fishing rod.
milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing as a proxy because no available rule type can directly detect a fishing rod hook event. Verifies player approached the zombie at very close range (within 4 blocks) and faced it precisely (30° tolerance). The zombie is at (~18, ~1, ~0) inside a separate pen behind the main spruce fence. The tight proximity and facing requirements combined with the player having a fishing rod make false positives unlikely during normal gameplay. Acknowledged approximation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate northwest to find the dark oak fence gate at (~-12, ~1, ~-8). The gate faces east, so the player approaches from the east side. Max distance 6 requires close approach.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jungle fence gate drops the jungle_fence_gate item into the player's inventory. The gate is at (~-13, ~1, ~-9), positioned behind the dark oak fence gate requiring passage through the dark oak area first. Fence gates always drop themselves when broken regardless of tool.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_trapdoor places the resulting item into the player's inventory. Recipe requires 6 dark oak planks in a 2x3 pattern on the crafting table at (~-14, ~0, ~-9). Player is given exactly 6 dark oak planks. Recipe yields 2 trapdoors.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate southwest to the villager house and find the lime bed at (~-11, ~1, ~10). The house door faces east (away from spawn) at (~-8, ~1, ~9), requiring the player to navigate around the building to enter. Max distance 5 ensures player is inside or at the doorway of the house.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the butcher villager places cooked chicken into the player's inventory. The level-5 butcher at (~-11, ~1, ~8) offers 8 cooked chicken per emerald. Player starts with 5 emeralds and 0 cooked chicken, so any cooked chicken in inventory confirms a successful trade.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Player must navigate north to the ice spikes area (z=-12 to -20) with tall packed ice columns on a snow/packed-ice floor. Target is the central tall column at (~0, ~4, ~-16). Max distance 8 requires entering the ice zone rather than just seeing it from afar.

Uses inventory_has because mining the blue terracotta block at (~0, ~2, ~-15) with the diamond pickaxe drops it as an item into the player's inventory. This also exposes the top face of the TNT block at (~0, ~1, ~-15) below it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most to verify the TNT block at (~0, ~1, ~-15) has been converted to a primed_tnt entity (block disappears from world). The TNT is encased in obsidian on all 4 sides and bottom, making it effectively impossible to mine (9.4s+ with diamond pickaxe vs instant flint&steel use). The player must use flint and steel on the exposed top face after removing the blue terracotta. The generous box (±2 XZ, 0-3 Y) ensures the check captures the TNT location.
